licensing_table.note: analysis-dependent: restricting the elative's distinct feminine shapes to non-follower position is recorded upstream as requiring review and as unsafe for automatic projection

rules.text: an attributive modifier is licensed only by simultaneous agreement on case, gender, number and definiteness against one head
referent animacy is a declared input and is applied before gender and number are set: a non-human plural head licenses feminine singular modification
definiteness is the axis that decides phrase versus predication; a definite head with an indefinite follower is not modification
after an annexation chain the modifier's case identifies its attachment target; where both members share a case the outcome is an explicit undecidable, emitted as such and not silently resolved
a post-nominal accusative that fails the definiteness parity test is not licensed as modification by resemblance -> reject_reconstruction
